defold/extension-firebase-analytics/firebase-analytics

Functions and constants for interacting with Firebase

  • GitHub: defold/extension-firebase-analytics — pinned to 3.3.1 (released while Defold 1.13.1 was current)
    1. Pick a release from defold/extension-firebase-analytics releases and add its Source code (zip) URL (or a packaged .zip asset, if the library ships one) to game.project under [project] dependencies, then Fetch Libraries in the Defold editor.
    2. Run bunx @defold-typescript/cli resolve to materialize its types.
    3. Import it under a namespace alias of your choice:

Functions

  • firebase.analytics.initialize()
  • firebase.analytics.set_callback(callback: function)
  • firebase.analytics.log(event_name: string)
  • firebase.analytics.log_string(event_name: string, param_name: string, param: string)
  • firebase.analytics.log_int(event_name: string, param_name: string, param: number)
  • firebase.analytics.log_number(event_name: string, param_name: string, param: number)
  • firebase.analytics.log_table(event_name: string, parameters: table)

  • firebase.analytics.set_user_id(user_id: string)

firebase.analytics.initialize()

Initialise analytics

firebase.analytics.set_callback(callback: function)

Sets a callback function for receiving events from the SDK. Call firebase.analytics.set_callback(nil) to remove callback

Parameters

  • callback: function — Callback function that is executed on any event in the SDK.
    • self: object — The calling script instance
    • message_id: number — One of message types: firebase.analytics.MSG_ERROR firebase.analytics.MSG_INSTANCE_ID
    • message: table — A table holding the data
      • error?: string — The error message (if an error occurred or nil otherwise)
      • instance_id?: string — For message_id MSG_INSTANCE_ID or nil otherwise.

firebase.analytics.log(event_name: string)

Log an event without parameters.

Parameters

  • event_name: string — Event name

firebase.analytics.log_string(event_name: string, param_name: string, param: string)

Log an event with one string parameter.

Parameters

  • event_name: string — Event name
  • param_name: string — Parameter name
  • param: string — Parameter value

firebase.analytics.log_int(event_name: string, param_name: string, param: number)

Log an event with one integer parameter.

Parameters

  • event_name: string — Event name
  • param_name: string — Parameter name
  • param: number — Parameter value

firebase.analytics.log_number(event_name: string, param_name: string, param: number)

Log an event with one float parameter.

Parameters

  • event_name: string — Event name
  • param_name: string — Parameter name
  • param: number — Parameter value

firebase.analytics.log_table(event_name: string, parameters: table)

Log an event with table parameters.

Parameters

  • event_name: string — Event name
  • parameters: table — Table with parameters (key-value pairs)

firebase.analytics.set_default_event_parameters(parameters: table)

Set default parameters that will be included with future events.

Parameters

  • parameters: table — Table with default parameters (key-value pairs)

firebase.analytics.set_user_id(user_id: string)

Sets the user ID property.

Parameters

  • user_id: string — User ID property

firebase.analytics.set_user_property(name: string, property: string)

Set a user property to the given value.

Parameters

  • name: string — User property name
  • property: string — User property value

firebase.analytics.reset()

Clears all data for this app from the device and resets the app instance id.

firebase.analytics.get_id()

Get the instance ID from the service. Returned in callback with MSG_INSTANCE_ID message_id.

firebase.analytics.set_enabled(enabled: boolean)

Sets whether analytics collection is enabled for this app on this device.

Parameters

  • enabled: boolean — The value
